title: Higher direct images commute with filtered colimits
statement:
Let $p\colon X\to Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $A$ a sheaf of rings on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$.
For every $q$, $R^qp_*$ on sheaves of $A$-modules commutes with filtered colimits and direct sums.

Here $X$ and $Y$ are schemes [def-pc-scheme], and quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness are as in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. The sites are the small pro-étale sites [sk-def-pe-site], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Module sheaves are those of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The direct image [det-pe-topos-functoriality-inverse-image] takes an $A$-module sheaf $M$ to the $p_*A$-module sheaf with sections $(p_*M)(V)=M(X\times_Y V)$. For $q\in\mathbf Z$, $R^qp_*(M)$ means $H^q(Rp_*(M[0]))$, where $M[0]$ is concentrated in degree zero, with right derivation and cohomology as in [def-sfb-right-derived-functor, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Colimits and direct sums are taken in these module-sheaf categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: For a filtered diagram M, form D = M composed with the degree-zero single-complex functor. For n < 0 its degree n object is zero by HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X. Apply boundedContinuityDirectImage from [det-pe-bounded-continuity-direct-image] at the common lower bound 0. The single-complex functor preserves colimits (Mathlib HomologicalComplexLimits), and colimit.post_post identifies the required comparison with the composite of this comparison and the derived-continuity comparison. Both factors are isomorphisms. The derived category and the comparisons are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

Prove additivity of ringDerivedDirectImage in a private helper. The localization Qh restricted to HomotopyCategory.KInjectives is full and faithful by the Mathlib Hom bijection into K-injectives. It is essentially surjective: resolve a representative of each derived object using ringModuleDirectImage_hasKInjectiveResolutions of [det-pe-bounded-continuity-direct-image]; the quasi-isomorphism gives the required derived isomorphism. The unit of [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] is invertible on K-injectives, identifying the composite of this localization with the chosen right derived functor with the restriction of the additive functor mapHomotopyCategory followed by Qh. Transport additivity across this natural isomorphism, then descend it through the full essentially surjective additive localization using Functor.additive_of_full_essSurj_comp. Composition with the additive single-complex, localization, and cohomology functors proves that the higher direct image on sheaves is additive. Thus it preserves finite coproducts, including the empty one, canonically and naturally.

proof.text: For any coefficient-universe set J, Finset (Discrete J) is a small filtered category, including the empty finite subset. Step 1 and preservesColimit_of_isIso_post give preservation of colimits of this shape by the additive functor of Step 2. Apply the source-library theorem CategoryTheory.Limits.preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_of_preservesColimitsOfShape_finset, which proves canonically by the coproduct universal property that an additive functor preserving these filtered finite subsums preserves coproducts indexed by J. Its finite-subsum argument includes the empty family. Colimits and coproducts use [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; their existence is supplied by Mathlib module-sheaf colimit instances, with no separate module-sheaf comparison theorem.
